messages.subject: Third, Intermediate color using gheatmap
messages.body_plain:
Is there a way to specify an intermediate color using gheatmap for continuous variables?

I have a specified high value color of yellow and a low value color of blue, but I would like intermediate values to be colored green with a blended range between them. Is that possible?

messages.subject: geom_cladelab specification for annotating with local images
messages.subject_clean: geom_cladelab specification for annotating with local images
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

I wish to add a local image as a clade label. Guangchuang's book has an example of annotating clades with phylopics but is missing the syntax for annotation using local images. Does anyone know how to do it?

I have tried specifying geom = 'image' and image within aes to 'local link', but without success.
geom_cladelab <https://rdrr.io/pkg/ggtree/man/geom_cladelab.html>(data = dt,   mapping = aes <https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/aes.html>(node = node, label = name,   image = link, color = name),   geom = "image")

Looking forward to hearing from you.
Best,
Martin
